test_policy.notes: First-year applicants with a 3.00+ cumulative unweighted GPA are admitted automatically and test scores are not required. Applicants with a 2.60-2.99 GPA must submit ACT/SAT scores or opt in to the Vandal Gateway Program; 2.30-2.59 are admitted through Vandal Gateway regardless of scores. International first-year applicants need at least a 2.5 GPA on the U.S. scale (converted by U of I).

requirements.notes: Apply through U of I's own application (the fee is $50 for international students, paid in the portal). International first-year students need a 2.5 GPA on a 4.0 scale as converted by the Admissions Office plus admissibility to university study in the home country; a Certificate of Financial Responsibility, bank statement and passport copy are required for the I-20. CDS (fall 2023 edition) rated GPA and test scores 'very important' and every other factor not considered.

deadlines.label: International fall 2027 application date (recommended latest)
deadlines.notes: U of I admits on a rolling basis with no hard deadline, but international applicants should apply at least three months before the start and no later than May 1 (fall), Oct 1 (spring) or Mar 1 (summer) to leave time for evaluation and the visa. The fall 2027 application opens in August 2026.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived with a previous degree from an accredited U.S. institution, or at the Admissions Office's judgment after passed English classes at U.S. institutions. Waiver requests are also accepted from citizens of listed English-speaking countries (e.g. UK, Ireland, Australia, Canada and several others; some require a school letter showing English medium of instruction). Other accepted proofs: SAT EBRW 550+, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency pass, Cambridge O Levels pass, ELS Level 112, SCEL Level 140, Lewis-Clark State Institute of Intensive English bridge program, or completing U of I's ALCP advanced level. Tests must be less than 2 years old.

english.notes: A pass on C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency (the page gives no numeric score).

aid.notes: Invitation to Idaho is awarded automatically (no application) to new international students admitted with a 3.0+ GPA who enroll full time: it lowers the published international tuition ($29,016 on the scholarship page) to $13,294, renewable 3 more years with a 2.5 U of I GPA. Those who do not qualify can apply for the #YouAreWelcomeHere scholarship (50% of tuition for up to four years; essay or video; 3.0 GPA to renew), which cannot be combined with Invitation to Idaho. International students cannot receive U.S. federal aid. English pathway: the on-campus American Language and Culture Program (ALCP); completing its advanced level satisfies the English requirement.

cost.notes: U of I 2026-27 undergraduate budget: tuition and fees are combined ($9,824 in-state, $29,300 non-resident, $13,538 for Invitation to Idaho/WUE recipients). total_coa_usd is the non-resident figure; with Invitation to Idaho it is $34,505. International students also pay an international student fee ($380 per semester, entered as $760) and required health insurance (about $2,412 a year), which are not in that total. Other = transportation $2,874 plus personal $3,838.
